attributes.board_name: New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions (State Board for Medicine)

topics.who: All physicians: infection control and barrier precautions (HIV/HBV) per Public Health Law §239, at initial licensure/registration and every four years; NYSDOH-approved providers
Applicants for licensure or limited permit: identification and reporting of child abuse and maltreatment (Education Law §6507(3)(a))
Prescribers with a DEA registration (and residents prescribing under a facility DEA number): pain management, palliative care and addiction, once every three years; attest to NYSDOH (NEAT)

rules.notes: No general CME hour requirement was found on the Office of the Professions physician pages; only mandated trainings apply. MDs and DOs are licensed in the same profession (medicine) by NYSED.
rules.legal_basis: Education Law §6507(3)(a); Public Health Law §239; NYSDOH mandatory prescriber education
